== Achievements ==
'''[[1999]]'''
* 7th place in last big polish QW 1on1 tournament known as Grudziadz Tournament, winner [[Macler]], runner-up [[Headhunter]].
'''[[2001]]'''
* Head admin of Official Polish Quake League, 4on4 and 1on1 editions.
* 3rd place in Official Polish 1on1 Tournament, winner [[Balt]], runner-up [[Zubek]].
'''[[2005]]'''
* 3rd place in Division 2 EQL1 with [[Death Dealers]], lost only 1 point to winners.
* Head admin of the first and second edition of Polish Duelmania.
'''[[2006]]'''
* 2nd place in Division 3 EQL4 with [[Easy To Kill]], lost 3 point to winners.
'''[[2007]]'''
* 2nd place in Division 2 EQL5 with [[Slackers2|Slackers2]], losing in DIV2 Final to [[Death Dealers]]. Division 1 next EQL.
'''[[2008]]'''
* Participation in QHLan 11, 3rd-6th January, Stockholm, Sweden
'''[[2010]]'''
* Play-off, 1st round stage in EQL11 DIV1 - 8th place - with [[Easy To Kill]], lost to [[The Viper Squad]]
